intro: Every photo below is our own crew on a real Miami-Dade property — no stock imagery. Lawns brought back on maintenance accounts, palms and oaks pruned to standard, removals in tight side yards, and stumps taken out below grade. If you want to see something closer to your own property, call and we will show you a job like it.

projects.title: Canopy thinning ahead of storm season
projects.alt: Tropical South crew member in a branded shirt, hard hat and safety harness trimming a tree from a Niftylift bucket against a clear blue sky
projects.description: Selective thinning from an aerial lift. Working from a lift instead of the tree lets the crew take the right limbs at the right point rather than whatever is reachable from a ladder.

projects.title: Oak trimmed back off the roofline
projects.alt: Articulated boom lift positioned in a driveway to reach a mature oak overhanging a single-storey home
projects.description: A mature oak lifted away from the roof and gutters before hurricane season, with the chipper staged on the street so the limbs never touched the lawn.

projects.title: Lawn brought back, front to back
projects.alt: Before and after of a poolside back lawn, overgrown on the left and evenly cut with clean edges on the right
projects.description: A regular maintenance account: cut to the right height for the turf, edged along the pool deck, and blown clean so no clippings ended up in the water.

projects.title: Date palm cleaned up
projects.alt: Before and after of a date palm, heavy with dead fronds on the left and pruned back to a clean crown on the right
projects.description: Dead fronds and seed pods removed without cutting into the live crown. Over-pruning a palm to a 'hurricane cut' weakens it — this is what a correct one looks like.

projects.title: Tight-access removal by spider lift
projects.alt: Compact tracked spider lift set up in a narrow side yard beside a two-storey house to reach a large tree
projects.description: The tracked lift fits through a side gate and spreads its weight across the turf, so we can reach trees behind the house without a truck on the lawn.

projects.title: Stump ground out below grade
projects.alt: Crew member operating a Toro STX-26 tracked stump grinder against a stump beside a wooden fence
projects.description: Ground down past ground level so the hole can be filled and the spot replanted or sodded. Most stumps are a few hours, even the large ones.

projects.title: Everything chipped and hauled away
projects.alt: Crew member feeding cut branches into a towable chipper on a residential street while a bucket lift works the tree behind
projects.description: Chipping as we cut is what keeps a tree job to one day. The chips can stay on site as mulch or leave in the truck — your call.

projects.title: Chipper and chip truck on site
projects.alt: Towable wood chipper hitched behind a chip truck parked on a residential driveway
projects.description: Our own equipment, not rented on the day. It is the difference between debris leaving with us and debris waiting at your curb for a second trip.

projects.title: Full removal, site cleared
projects.alt: Sectioned trunk and root mass cut down to grade with the surrounding hedge left intact
projects.description: Taken down in sections so nothing swung into the hedge or the neighbouring property, then cut to grade ready for grinding.

projects.title: Shade tree over a maintained lawn
projects.alt: A mature shade tree with a full canopy over a healthy, freshly cut South Florida lawn
projects.description: What a property looks like when the tree work and the lawn care are handled by the same crew on the same schedule.
